worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.summary: Slash the selected target, ignoring its stat-stage changes.
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.use.0: Draw the long horn back and send the longest cut forward
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.use.1: Ignore the target's raised Defence stages outright
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.use.2: Open a single target at the edge of reach
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.descriptio: One cut deals about %1$s contact damage out to about %2$s blocks; the target's Defence stages are ignored by this move.
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.iaido.on: Iai form: reach about %1$s blocks, lunge about %2$s blocks and about %3$s damage per cut - farther and harder, but a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.iaido.off: Standing form: cut on the spot, reach about %1$s blocks, lunge about %2$s blocks and about %3$s damage, with a faster cycle.
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.growth.0: At level %1$s the cut power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.growth.1: At level %1$s the cut power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.sacredsword.preference: On (iai): lunge x1.6, reach +0.3 and x1.06 per cut, at the cost of +3 ticks of wind-up, +1 of recovery and +5 of cooldown. Off (standing): cut on the spot with slightly less reach and power but a faster cycle. Each direction has its moment: iai against a farther single target, standing against a target already in your face.
